title: Common hook input
description: Fields sent to every hook. The Claude Code fields keep their Claude Code names and meaning; every Zed-only field lives under the `zed` object so that it can never collide with a future Claude Code field.
$comment: Fragment: closed by the including event schema through unevaluatedProperties: false.

session_id.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:736). Identifier of the root agent conversation. Inside a subagent it stays the identifier of the root conversation, as in Claude Code; the current conversation is `zed.thread_id`.

transcript_path.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:738). Always null in Zed: Zed keeps conversations in its database and writes no transcript file. Sent so that Claude Code scripts reading it get a defined value.

cwd.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:739). Absolute path of the first worktree root of the project.

hook_event_name.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:743). Name of the event that fired.

agent_id.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:749). Present only when the hook fires inside a subagent: identifier of that subagent (its Zed thread id).

agent_type.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:750). Present only inside a subagent. Zed has no agent types: the value is the `label` the parent gave to `spawn_agent`.

zed.description: Zed extension. Contract version and thread position.

ZedContext.description: Zed extension block, present in every input.

contract_version.description: Version of this contract (semantic versioning). Scripts compare the major number.

thread_id.description: Identifier of the conversation (thread) the event belongs to. Stable across Zed restarts; a hook uses it to file its own state under ZED_HOOK_DATA_DIR (Zed keeps no hook state).

parent_thread_id.description: Identifier of the parent conversation for a subagent, null for a root conversation.

is_subagent.description: True when the conversation is a subagent.

depth.description: 0 for a root conversation, 1 for its subagents, 2 for theirs, and so on.
